mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot WHERE p_num = #{pNum} ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.* FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT p_num, MAX(snapshot_time) AS max_time FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot GROUP BY p_num ) t ON s.p_num = t.p_num AND s.snapshot_time = t.max_time ORDER BY CASE s.risk_level WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 WHEN 'SAFE' THEN 5 END

SELECT s.* FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT p_num, MAX(snapshot_time) AS max_time FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot GROUP BY p_num ) t ON s.p_num = t.p_num AND s.snapshot_time = t.max_time WHERE s.risk_level = #{riskLevel}

SELECT s.risk_level AS riskLevel, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot s INNER JOIN ( SELECT p_num, MAX(snapshot_time) AS max_time FROM biz_inventory_risk_snapshot GROUP BY p_num ) t ON s.p_num = t.p_num AND s.snapshot_time = t.max_time GROUP BY s.risk_level
